results: hwp: Ctrl+T deletes a reversed scalar selection, undo/redo and actual save/reopen
hwp: held Ctrl+T repeats word deletion, undo preserves each actual edit
hwp: held font-size increments apply twice without repeating a toggle and persist
hwp: Ctrl+Alt+V opens text-only paste; selection, undo and save stay connected
hwp: Shift document and paragraph boundaries preserve and reverse an existing selection without modifying bytes
hwp: F3 block selection survives unmodified document boundary navigation
hwp: Ctrl+Alt+A cycles superscript/subscript/normal, preserves other effects and saves
hwp: Alt+Shift+F/G follow current local font order with repeat, undo and save
hwpx: Ctrl+T deletes a reversed scalar selection, undo/redo and actual save/reopen
hwpx: held Ctrl+T repeats word deletion, undo preserves each actual edit
hwpx: held font-size increments apply twice without repeating a toggle and persist
hwpx: Ctrl+Alt+V opens text-only paste; selection, undo and save stay connected
hwpx: Shift document and paragraph boundaries preserve and reverse an existing selection without modifying bytes
hwpx: F3 block selection survives unmodified document boundary navigation
hwpx: Ctrl+Alt+A cycles superscript/subscript/normal, preserves other effects and saves
font-cycle shortcut honors the selected language slot without rewriting other font families
caret script cycling changes pending typing properties and applies to subsequently typed text only
Ctrl+Shift+Home/End select the visible screen edge instead of jumping to document start/end
synthetic AltGraph and IME safeguards leave actual document, selection and dialogs unchanged
